canonical.question: What account-to-account transfer rule and ticket-account retention rule does the Eventbrite ticket-transfer guidance give?
canonical.expected_primary: It is not possible to transfer a ticket from one account to another.
canonical.expected_secondary: This does not remove the ticket from your Eventbrite account
canonical.tampered_primary: You can transfer a ticket to another account instantly without approval.
